This '''pin-up of a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]]''' was a decorative [[Painting/Legends|poster]] available on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Pursuit" />

It was seen on the wall of [[Moshi Bar/Legends|Moshi Bar]]<ref name="Lethal">{{TCW|Lethal Trackdown}}</ref> and an [[Unidentified Coruscant cantina/Legends|unidentified cantina]] in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]], and in [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] and [[Moralo Eval/Legends|Moralo Eval's]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] cell in the [[Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center]].<ref name="Deception">{{TCW|Deception}}</ref> Addressed to an individual named [[Jason (Rodian pin-up)/Legends|Jason]], the image depicted a [[Color/Legends|green]]-skinned<ref name="Pursuit" /> [[Gender/Legends|female]]<ref name="Trivia">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/lethal-trackdown-trivia-gallery|text="Lethal Trackdown" Trivia Gallery|quote=The nightclub on Coruscant is filled with posters of various female pin-up models}} {{C|Slide 6}}</ref> [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] with short, orange [[Hair/Legends|hair]], wearing a blue dress and white stockings. The [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] inscription on the upper-right corner of the image read "To Jason X0X0".<ref name="Pursuit" />

==Behind the scenes==
This image was one of several pin-up images seen on the walls [[Moshi Bar/Legends|Moshi Bar]] in the episode ''[[Lethal Trackdown]]''. In the episode, the poster is seen from far away and the Aurebesh caption is barely readable.<ref name="Lethal" /> The poster is first seen in close-up in an [[Unidentified Coruscant cantina/Legends|unidentified cantina]] in ''[[Pursuit of Peace]]''.<ref name="Pursuit" />
